answer: Each agent locks a 60-credit willow bond on one lagoon post, on the ocean log. Each epoch random auditors sample posts, demanding a fresh willow-signed proof from that post's agent. Fake posts burn their bond and pay the auditor 40; false claims burn the auditor 20. First fake 70, k-th 70+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,067,000 and lock 60,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented posts fail: one proof, one post, one tide. Honest agents pay 70 once, keep the bond.
